message.content: The capital of Australia is **Canberra**. It's a purpose-built city located in the Australian Capital Territory (ACT), between Sydney and Melbourne. It was chosen as a compromise capital in 1908, partly to settle the rivalry between Sydney and Melbourne, both of which wanted to be the capital.
